title: THE TITLE FITS A 4K SCREEN, NO FALSE ERROR
why: His order of 2026-10-12 (#50), and today: take pictures and make sure the menus actually look good. The 4K picture of the title showed two faults. The bottom of the title ran off the screen, so CREATE A NEW SAVE was cut in half: the title is shrunk to fit a big screen, and the fit left out the margin round it. It counts the margin now. And every 4K title said ERROR SAVED TO YOUR RUN REPORT: the browser posts a harmless notice when the title resizes itself inside its own resize watcher, and the crash catcher logged it as a crash. The resize now waits a frame, and that notice is no longer a crash.
now: The title fits a 4K screen with nothing cut off, and it no longer says ERROR SAVED TO YOUR RUN REPORT when it opens.

edits.anchor: try{ if(col&&typeof ResizeObserver==='function') new ResizeObserver(function(){ if(ti.classList.contains('on')) titleFit(); }).observe(col); }catch(_ro){}
edits.replacement:
// v16.xx (ui5b): the refit waits for the next frame; changing the zoom inside the callback made the browser post a loop notice
  try{ if(col&&typeof ResizeObserver==='function') new ResizeObserver(function(){ if(titleFit.raf) return; titleFit.raf=requestAnimationFrame(function(){ titleFit.raf=0; if(ti.classList.contains('on')) titleFit(); }); }).observe(col); }catch(_ro){}
